title: Ansel and the Protocol
author: Noor Underhill
blurb: August Yarrow, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
